visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a top-down view of several coffin-shaped pins arranged on a light-colored wooden surface. The pins feature black-and-white manga illustrations of characters like Tomie, Ryusuke, and Soichi, framed by ornate red and gold borders. A hand enters the frame, adjusting the position of a pin titled 'TOMIE'. (2) The lighting suddenly shifts to total darkness, revealing the glow-in-the-dark property of the pins. The character illustrations emit a bright, eerie green luminescence against the black background. (3) The light returns, and the camera focuses on a 'Junji Ito Maniae' branded box held by two hands. The box is decorated with gothic patterns and character portraits. The hands proceed to open the top flap and pull out a silver foil blind bag. (4) For the remainder of the video, the hands unbox individual pins from foil bags, separating them from white paper liners. Each pin is held close to the lens, showing the detailed character art on the front and the silver-colored safety pin backing. The camera uses small panning movements to follow the hands as they showcase 'SOICHI', 'TOMIE', 'RYUSUKE', and 'THE BOY AT THE CROSSROADS' pins in sequence.

A female voice sings 'Tonight You Belong To Me' with a soft, breathy, and nostalgic delivery. (2) SFX: A sharp, crisp tearing sound as a foil bag is opened. This noise overlaps with the melodic guitar. (3) SFX: A metallic 'click' as a pin is flipped over or set down. The female vocals continue to dominate the mix with moderate harmonic purity. (4) SFX: High-frequency rustling of paper and foil occurs consistently as more bags are opened. The BGM remains steady in tempo and volume, providing a bright contrast to the implied horror theme of the visual content.
